resources.string: No language is on. Turn one on in “Voice input” in the settings.
%1$s: no connection to the download server
In the developer settings, turn on “USB debugging” (under “Debugging”). Come back and press “Connect”: Lumbina turns its service on by itself.
Debugging is on. Press “Connect”: Lumbina turns its service on by itself.
A request appears on the screen: tick “Always allow” and press “Allow”. Then Lumbina turns its service on, which takes a few seconds.
The device didn’t allow the connection. Press “Connect” again and choose “Allow”. If no request appeared, restart the device and try again.
The connection was allowed only once. Press “Connect” again, tick “Always allow” and choose “Allow”.
Connected, but this device does not allow Lumbina to keep its service on. Turn the service on in the system settings, under “Accessibility”, or from a computer.
Debugging is on, but Lumbina could not connect. Press “Connect” again; if it keeps failing, the diagnostics report says why.
Debugging is off: turn it on in the developer settings and press “Connect”.

For Home to open Lumbina, turn on Lumbina in the system settings, under “Accessibility”. It stays on after a restart; should the system turn it off anyway (after a crash, say), Home opens the device’s own launcher again: then turn it on there once more.
Home opens the device’s own launcher now. For it to open Lumbina, turn the remote’s service on once, from a computer.
Apps show their picks and what you have not finished on the home screen. The device will now ask to let Lumbina read the channels.
This is optional. You can change it in the settings, under “Channels”.
The permission was not given. “Continue watching” and “Recommendations” stay empty until it is: see “Channels” in Lumbina’s settings.
Done: Lumbina can read the channels.
To show the bell and what is playing now, Lumbina needs access to notifications. It is given in the device’s settings.
Access to notifications is not given yet. Open the settings again or put the step off.
This device does not let that screen open.
A launcher for a TV, a set-top box and a projector. A few short steps; any of them can be put off.
You can go on: the download continues by itself.
Lumbina is ready. What you put off stays in the settings, under “About Lumbina”.
Меняется только язык Lumbina. Изменить можно в настройках, в разделе «Вид и язык».
Only Lumbina’s language changes. You can change it in the settings, under “View and language”.
On a computer on the same network, with adb installed, run these. The QR code holds the same text, to pass it on from a phone.
Replace <IP> with this device’s address: it is in the device settings, under “Network”, in your network’s details.
